accepts.because: a digest run demanded NOW, outside the timer: the same body the schedule emits -- one `tool_call` turn whose text is the JSON arguments carrying the URL. `chat_id` must be promoted to context by the caller (a string, as the timer's own header is), because the formatter recasts it into the delivery header and cannot invent one

emits.because: the formatted digest of a run that was demanded from outside, handed back to whoever demanded it instead of being pushed into this bot's own chat. A scheduled run goes to the notifier and never reaches this lane

description.purpose: Composes timer, web_fetch, formatter and Telegram proxy into a linear scheduled push pipeline.
description.use_when: Daily one-URL digest to one chat, or a run demanded from outside on lane in_digest. Non-2xx fetches have no edge -- they dead-letter (wire a failure branch if you need alerting).
description.not_in_scope: No retries, no aggregation, no summarization.
examples: cron -> fetcher -> format -> notifier. chat_id travels: timer emit_headers (string) -> context on edge 1 -> recast to number by format -> context on edge 3. A run demanded at the hive path on lane in_digest enters at the fetcher with context.digest_origin 'parent' and its formatted digest leaves at the hive path on lane digest instead of going to the notifier; the caller brings context.chat_id itself.
